meta.title: Weekend Getaways from Toronto
meta.subtitle: Two trips, one weekend
meta.all_prices_are_for: two people together, unless a line says per_person
notes: Coordinates are deliberately omitted. Every place has a maps_query string instead — feed it to Google Maps, Mapbox geocoding, or an embed URL.
cost.amount of 0 means genuinely free. cost.amount of null means unknown/needs a phone call.
data_source on a stop or lodging option names where the numbers came from and when. Anything without one is still my estimate.

Every stop is guaranteed to have: time, name, type, description, duration_min, cost{amount,per,note}, maps_query, tags[], address. Any of these may be null, but the key is always present. Everything else is optional.
meta.revision_note: v3.0 - replaced all six trips with the two final lists (North and Quebec City) after a fresh verification sweep on 2026-09-30. Unconfirmed items carry a caveat on the stop.

trips.name: North — Huntsville & Dorset
trips.tagline: Floating boardwalk, a forest full of lights, and that tower view!
trips.summary: Saturday is all Huntsville: the market in Bracebridge first, then the floating boardwalk, Limberlost, the Sandhill festival, dinner at Tall Trees, sunset at Lion's Lookout and the Forest of Light after dark. Sunday is Dorset early, then waterfalls and cranberries on the way home.
trips.why_this_trip: Close, all nature, and one night-time thing - the Forest of Light - that only happens in October.

stops.name: Toronto to Muskoka
stops.description: Up the 400 and onto Highway 11 after work. About two hours to Bracebridge.

stops.name: Bracebridge Farmers' Market
stops.description: Saturday morning market in Bracebridge. Coffee, baking and whatever the farms still have in October.

cost.note: Free to walk; bring cash for stalls

stops.caveat: Whether Oct 10 is still inside the market season is unconfirmed - it may already have closed for the year.

stops.name: Bracebridge to Huntsville
stops.description: Highway 11 north, about 35 minutes.

stops.name: Hunters Bay floating boardwalk
stops.description: A trail that floats across the water at the edge of Huntsville. It is an out-and-back, not a loop - about 4.6 km one way - so walk out as far as feels good and turn around.
tips: Out-and-back only - plan a partial and turn around, rather than committing to the full 9+ km.

stops.name: Lunch in downtown Huntsville
stops.description: Main Street, a short walk from the boardwalk.

stops.name: Limberlost Forest, Buck Lake trail
stops.description: Private forest reserve east of Huntsville with lakeside trails. The Buck Lake trail is the one from the list.
stops.maps_query: Limberlost Forest and Wildlife Reserve, Huntsville, ON

stops.name: Sandhill Nursery Fall Festival
stops.description: The daytime fall festival at Sandhill Nursery, the same grounds that light up as the Forest of Light tonight.
stops.maps_query: Sandhill Nursery, 1686 Aspdin Road, Huntsville, ON

stops.name: Tall Trees
stops.description: The only proper dinner of the weekend, in an old white house in the woods off Main Street. Booked early so the lookout still fits before the Forest of Light.
stops.maps_query: Tall Trees Muskoka, 87 Main Street West, Huntsville, ON
stops.address: 87 Main St W, Huntsville, ON P1H 1X1
stops.booking: Reserve early. 2-hour seatings; $50/person cancellation fee with under 5 hours' notice.
stops.hours: Closed Sunday and Monday - Saturday is the only dinner night that works
stops.caveat: Kitchen closes at 9pm. Ask for the earliest seating so there is time for Lion's Lookout at sunset before the Forest of Light.

stops.name: Lion's Lookout at sunset
stops.description: Five minutes from downtown. The whole of Huntsville, Fairy Lake and the hills in one view. Sunset is around 6:40pm.

stops.name: Sandhill Fall Forest of Light
stops.description: A lit walk through the forest at Sandhill Nursery. Saturday Oct 10 is a Classic night.
stops.maps_query: Sandhill Nursery, 1686 Aspdin Road, Huntsville, ON
stops.booking: Advance tickets only - sells out. Book now.
stops.caveat: The ~$56 figure is not confirmed; an earlier ~$20 figure turned out to be the youth price.

stops.name: Huntsville to Bracebridge
stops.description: Back south on Highway 11, about 35 minutes.

stops.name: Bracebridge "Lighting of the Falls"
stops.description: Bracebridge Falls lit in colour at night, in the middle of town. A free add-on on the way back.
stops.caveat: That this is a scheduled event on Saturday evening is unconfirmed.

stops.name: Bracebridge to Dorset
stops.description: East on Highway 117 along Lake of Bays, about 50 minutes.

stops.name: Dorset Lookout Tower

tips: Go early Sunday - weekend crowding is real.

stops.name: Peek-a-Boo Rock boardwalk
stops.description: A short boardwalk right at the base of the tower. Zero detour.

stops.name: Dorset to Bracebridge
stops.description: Back west along Highway 117.

stops.name: Wilson's Falls
stops.description: A waterfall trail on the edge of Bracebridge. Short and free.

stops.name: Johnston's Cranberry Marsh

warnings: Colour is at or near peak right now. By Oct 10-11 expect the golden encore - reds fading, golds coming on. Still beautiful.

Saturday evening is tight: dinner at 5, the lookout at 6:30, the Forest of Light by 7:15. Tall Trees' kitchen closes at 9.
No lodging has been chosen yet.

dates.label: Thanksgiving weekend
why: Saturday Oct 10 is a Classic night at the Forest of Light.
Colour is at or near peak now; the golden encore should hold through Oct 10-11.
dates.note: Monday Oct 12 is the Thanksgiving holiday, so a third day is available if you want it.
dates.collision: Same weekend as Quebec City. Pick one.

trips.name: Quebec City
trips.tagline: Big valley hike, old stone streets, and thousands of snow geese!
trips.summary: Friday as far as Montreal. Saturday climbs Les Loups above the Jacques-Cartier valley, walks Old Quebec, then heads to Wendake for Onhwa' Lumina, a lit forest walk after dark. Sunday runs down the river - Montmorency, Canyon Sainte-Anne, the snow geese at Cap Tourmente - and ends on Île d'Orléans before the long drive home.
trips.why_this_trip: Cap Tourmente's snow geese are here now and gone by November. Colour across the region is at or near peak, and the first week of October is called ideal.

stops.name: Alt Hotel Montreal

stops.name: Montreal to Jacques-Cartier
stops.description: Up the 40 past Quebec City and north into the valley, about three hours.
stops.maps_query: Montreal, QC to Parc national de la Jacques-Cartier, QC

stops.name: Les Loups trail, Parc national de la Jacques-Cartier
stops.description: The climb above the Jacques-Cartier valley. Legitimately strenuous - not a small hike - and the view at the top is the whole valley in colour.
stops.maps_query: Parc national de la Jacques-Cartier, Stoneham, QC
stops.booking: Reserve the Sépaq day pass online ahead - the park has a daily visitor cap.

stops.name: Lunch in Stoneham
stops.description: On the way out of the park, twenty minutes from the old town.

stops.name: Old Quebec
stops.description: Dufferin Terrace and the Château Frontenac above the river, then down the Breakneck Stairs into Petit-Champlain and out onto Place Royale.

stops.name: Oh mon kogo
stops.description: Korean street food - corn dogs - on Rue Saint-Jean. A snack stop, not dinner.
stops.maps_query: Oh mon kogo, 1120 Rue Saint-Jean, Quebec City, QC
stops.caveat: Possibly closed - one listing says permanently closed, others show open hours. Verify before going.

stops.name: Onhwa' Lumina
stops.description: A 1.2 km night walk through the Saint-Rémy woods in Wendake, lit up with light and sound by Moment Factory. Seven zones telling Huron-Wendat stories, about 50 minutes. Twenty minutes from the old town.
stops.maps_query: Onhwa' Lumina, 110 rue Grand Chef Thonnakona, Wendake, QC
stops.address: 110 rue Grand Chef Thonnakona, Wendake, QC G0A 4V0
stops.booking: Book a timed entry online ahead - 7:00pm fits after the corn dogs.

stops.name: Dinner in Old Quebec
stops.description: Back into the old town after the forest. Quebecois classics, or Korean - Madang (4.7, 423 reviews) and Chicken & Bap (4.9, 717 reviews) are both strong but outside the walls.

stops.name: Montmorency Falls
stops.description: 83 metres, thirty metres taller than Niagara. A footbridge crosses directly above the lip, and a cable car runs up the cliff face in about two minutes. Park entry is free; you pay for the cable car.

cost.note: About $25 per adult for return cable car. Guided version ~$35. Park entry free.

stops.maps_query: Parc de la Chute-Montmorency, Quebec QC

stops.name: Canyon Sainte-Anne
stops.description: A 74-metre waterfall in a gorge, crossed by suspension bridges.

stops.name: Lunch in Beaupré
stops.description: Between the canyon and the geese.

stops.name: Cap Tourmente
stops.description: Tens of thousands of snow geese stop here on the way south. There is a daily "focus on geese" program through Nov 1. Ephemeral, and the star of the trip - do not skip.
stops.maps_query: Réserve nationale de faune du Cap-Tourmente, Saint-Joachim, QC
stops.caveat: The geese arrived around Sep 20-21; whether Oct 11 is peak timing is unconfirmed.

stops.name: Île d'Orléans
stops.description: Cross the bridge just past the falls onto a farming island where some houses date to the 1600s. Cider houses, chocolatiers, bakeries, a single road around the edge with the river on one side.

cost.note: Estimate from the earlier plan, which had lunch here too; tastings alone should come in under it

stops.caveat: Hours vary by source - Cassis Monna & Filles 10am-5 or 6pm, the chocolaterie 9am-8pm. Confirm day-of.

stops.name: Drive home
stops.description: About eight hours back to Toronto. Monday is the holiday.
stops.maps_query: Quebec City, QC to Toronto, ON

lodging.searched_for: 2026-10-16 to 2026-10-18, 2 nights, 2 adults, Quebec City (old search)
lodging.prices_are: total for the whole stay, two people
lodging.finding: Location matters more here than anywhere else - the entire trip is Old Quebec on foot. Paying $70 more to sleep inside the walls is worth it.

options.name: Auberge St-Louis
options.note: Right on rue Saint-Louis, steps from Chateau Frontenac. Basic, but you are walking out the door into the old town.

options.name: Hotel et Motel Le Chateauguay
options.note: Beauport, so out of the old town - but close to Montmorency Falls, and it has a pool, sauna and hot tub.

options.name: Econo Lodge Airport Quebec
options.note: Sensible if you fly and pick up a car, otherwise too far out.

options.name: Hotel Le Littoral
options.note: Has a spa with couples massage.

lodging.recommended: Auberge St-Louis - inside the walls, so the night walk starts at the door.
lodging.caveat: These rates were for Oct 16-18, checked Sep 15. You need ONE night, Sat Oct 10, on Thanksgiving weekend - re-check everything. Friday is Alt Hotel Montreal.

bookings.name: Onhwa' Lumina
bookings.note: Sat Oct 10, 7:00pm entry. $33.75+tax per adult, parking $10.50.

bookings.name: Old Quebec, Saturday night
bookings.note: One night, Oct 10, Thanksgiving weekend. Re-check rates.

bookings.name: Oh mon kogo

warnings: Sunday ends with about eight hours of driving from Île d'Orléans. Home very late - Monday is the holiday.
Les Loups is legitimately strenuous: 10.5-11 km, 3.5-4 hours, 450 m+ of climbing. Not a small hike.
Sunday's closing times are the constraint: Canyon Sainte-Anne last entry 4pm, Cap Tourmente closes 5pm. Keep the order.
Quebec City is overwhelmingly French-speaking. English is understood in tourist areas but far less than Montreal. Neither of you speaks French - worth knowing, not a reason to skip it.

alternatives.name: Mont-Sainte-Anne gondola
alternatives.reason: Verified running, but the operator lists 10am-4pm Fri-Sun. It collides with Canyon Sainte-Anne's 4pm last entry and Cap Tourmente's 5pm close. It is the least unique item and the one that breaks the day - Les Loups already gives the mountain panoramas.

dates.label: Thanksgiving weekend
why: Snow geese at Cap Tourmente: the daily geese program runs through Nov 1.
Colour across the region is at or near peak; the first week of October is called ideal.
Canyon Sainte-Anne is open until Oct 25.
Onhwa' Lumina runs every night Oct 9-12, not just Friday and Saturday.
dates.note: Monday Oct 12 is the Thanksgiving holiday - it absorbs the late drive home.
dates.collision: Same weekend as the North trip. Pick one.

rental_car.note: YYZ rates advertise from about $15-28/day base. Budget $50/day plus the airport concession fee, roughly 10-15% on top.

getting_there.alternative: Free if someone drops you off

rental_car.tip: Check whether returning to a city branch instead of the airport dodges the concession fee.
